fix(effect): generate schemas for +json, charset and url-encoded bodies (#4408)

`@orval/effect` only matched exact `application/json` and
`multipart/form-data`, so `application/hal+json`,
`application/json; charset=utf-8` and `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`
bodies and responses got no schema. Match content types the way
`@orval/zod` does since #3433: `+json` vendor types count as JSON, media
type parameters are ignored, and url-encoded bodies get a plain object
schema whose binary fields stay strings, since URLSearchParams only
carries strings.

Fixes #4407
